# Route map

<!-- Generated by `npm run routes:map`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Pages live in `src/app/[locale]/**/page.tsx`. The URL is the folder path without `[locale]` and without `(group)` folders; `[id]` becomes `:id`. A **view** is the screen body a page renders (`src/features/<feature>/views/`); everything else in `components/` is a reusable piece. See ADR-047.

| URL | Page file (`src/app/`) | View in `src/features/` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/` | `[locale]/page.tsx` | — |
| `/*` | `[locale]/[...rest]/page.tsx` | — |
| `/friends` | `[locale]/(app)/friends/page.tsx` | `friends/views/friends-panel.tsx` |
| `/friends/join/:code` | `[locale]/(app)/friends/join/[code]/page.tsx` | `friends/views/join-friend.tsx` |
| `/games` | `[locale]/(app)/games/(list)/page.tsx` | — |
| `/games/:id` | `[locale]/(app)/games/[id]/page.tsx` | `catalog/views/game-detail.tsx` |
| `/games/:id/edit` | `[locale]/(app)/games/[id]/edit/page.tsx` | `catalog/views/custom-game-form.tsx` |
| `/games/:id/plays/:playId` | `[locale]/(app)/games/[id]/plays/[playId]/page.tsx` | `plays/views/play-form.tsx` |
| `/games/:id/plays/:playId/live` | `[locale]/(app)/games/[id]/plays/[playId]/live/page.tsx` | `plays/views/live-play.tsx` |
| `/games/:id/plays/new` | `[locale]/(app)/games/[id]/plays/new/page.tsx` | `plays/views/play-form.tsx` |
| `/games/:id/sheets` | `[locale]/(app)/games/[id]/sheets/page.tsx` | — |
| `/games/:id/sheets/:sheetId` | `[locale]/(app)/games/[id]/sheets/[sheetId]/page.tsx` | `scoring/views/sheet-editor.tsx`, `scoring/views/sheet-view.tsx` |
| `/games/:id/sheets/new` | `[locale]/(app)/games/[id]/sheets/new/page.tsx` | `scoring/views/sheet-editor.tsx` |
| `/games/new` | `[locale]/(app)/games/new/page.tsx` | `catalog/views/custom-game-form.tsx` |
| `/groups` | `[locale]/(app)/groups/page.tsx` | `groups/views/groups-manager.tsx` |
| `/home` | `[locale]/(app)/home/page.tsx` | — |
| `/library` | `[locale]/(app)/library/page.tsx` | `library/views/library-view.tsx` |
| `/log` | `[locale]/(app)/log/page.tsx` | — |
| `/nights` | `[locale]/(app)/nights/page.tsx` | `nights/views/nights-home.tsx` |
| `/nights/:id` | `[locale]/(app)/nights/[id]/page.tsx` | `nights/views/night-detail.tsx` |
| `/nights/new` | `[locale]/(app)/nights/new/page.tsx` | `nights/views/night-picker.tsx` |
| `/players` | `[locale]/(app)/players/page.tsx` | `players/views/players-manager.tsx` |
| `/plays/elsewhere` | `[locale]/(app)/plays/elsewhere/page.tsx` | — |
| `/settings` | `[locale]/(app)/settings/page.tsx` | — |
| `/sign-in/*` | `[locale]/(auth)/sign-in/[[...sign-in]]/page.tsx` | — |
| `/sign-up/*` | `[locale]/(auth)/sign-up/[[...sign-up]]/page.tsx` | — |
| `/stats` | `[locale]/(app)/stats/page.tsx` | `stats/views/my-stats.tsx` |
